name: Work Permit

requirements.blocker_text: A work permit is required for any non-national working in Trinidad and Tobago for more than 30 days within a 12-month period; visits of 30 days or less do not require one.
Applications are submitted by the employer on behalf of the foreign worker via TTBizLink.

evidence_required.document: Supporting documents (submitted at Ministry of National Security office)
Work permit fee (amount not disclosed on the pages reviewed)

outcome.duration_length: not specified in the sources reviewed

sources.title: ttconnect, Government of Trinidad and Tobago -- Work Permit: 30-day threshold triggering the requirement, employer-submitted TTBizLink application (1-9 persons) or manual group application (10+), Work Permit Help Desk contact

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Trinidad and Tobago's initial build. No fee amount, permit duration, or explicit labour-market-test requirement was found on the ttconnect or Ministry of National Security/Homeland Security pages reviewed -- flagged as a gap; the process confirms employer-only submission but does not itemise a local-recruitment-first rule as clearly as some other countries' equivalent pages this session. leads_to_pr/pr_after_months (60 months) reflects the general 5-year continuous-lawful-residence route to permanent resident status (see tt_permanent_residence_general.json), for which work permits are an explicitly permissible qualifying permit type per secondary legal-commentary sources.
